PostToolUse.command: case "$FILE_PATH" in *.rs) ~/.cargo/bin/cargo fmt --manifest-path "$(dirname "$FILE_PATH")/../Cargo.toml" 2>/dev/null || ~/.cargo/bin/cargo fmt 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac
PostToolUse.description: Auto-format Rust source files after every edit

PostToolUse.command: case "$FILE_PATH" in */lsp/src/*.rs) ~/.cargo/bin/cargo clippy -p todo-highlight-lsp -- -D warnings 2>&1 | head -40 ;; esac
PostToolUse.description: Run clippy on LSP crate after edits to lsp/src/
